subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Their teacher explained that seeds can protect food diversity.”?
options: Relying on only a few crops can be risky when climate or disease changes.
A map can help people understand the world, but it can also quietly teach them where they think the center is.
If a plant disease, war, or climate problem destroys crops in one area, stored seeds may help people grow them again.
It became a lesson in problem-solving: when land, food, and cities change, people must imagine new ways to grow.
